clue.text: Male beheld tool

parts.note: a buck is a male deer or rabbit
beheld means saw, the past tense of see

explanation.surface: A man is spotted looking at some piece of equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A bucksaw is a woodcutting saw set in an H-shaped frame, a type of hand implement.

clue.text: Halve slice with dry content

indicators.note: content says the dry piece forms the contents of the slice word

parts.note: a bit is a piece or slice
sec is the French wine term for dry

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: cut a portion in two with a dry filling.
explanation.definitionFit: To bisect is to cut into two equal parts, a synonym for halve.

clue.text: Brainboxes coming up with a popular line

indicators.note: in a down entry coming up means reading from bottom to top

parts.note: in means popular or fashionable
an arc is a curved line

explanation.surface: Clever people arriving with a well-liked chat-up line.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brainboxes' means clever people in the surface, but here it means skulls, the boxes holding brains.
explanation.definitionFit: The cranium is the part of the skull enclosing the brain, so a literal container for brains.

clue.text: They load the day before and delivery's first in shops

indicators.note: in says the day and the delivery letter go inside the shops

parts.note: stores are shops
eve is the day before a festival, as Christmas Eve

indicators.note: first says only the opening letter of delivery is wanted

explanation.surface: Warehouse staff stock shelves the day before, with delivery coming first.
explanation.definitionFit: Stevedores are dockers who load and unload ships' cargo.

clue.text: She in country and western? On the contrary

indicators.note: On the contrary says to take the clue's order the other way about, the western letter first

parts.note: Oman is a country on the Arabian peninsula

explanation.surface: A female singer working in country and western music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country and western' reads as the music genre, but gives OMAN then W, which 'On the contrary' flips.
explanation.definitionFit: She is the pronoun for a female person.

clue.text: Married in church, consummated outside

indicators.note: outside says the word for consummated wraps around the church abbreviation

parts.note: mated means coupled, as a marriage is consummated

explanation.surface: A couple wed in church and then completed the marriage afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Matched can mean paired off as a couple, a synonym for wedded.

clue.text: African city, where tool wielded in demonstration

indicators.note: wielded in says the tool is held within the demonstration word

parts.note: a march is a protest demonstration
a rake is a garden tool

explanation.surface: Somewhere in Africa, a protester brandishes an implement at a rally.
explanation.definitionFit: Marrakech is a major city in Morocco, in North Africa.

clue.text: Country for taking away

definitions.meaning: food ... is takeaway food, bought to eat elsewhere

explanation.surface: A nation whose name is also a takeaway order.
explanation.definitionFit: Togo is a West African state, and 'to go' is the phrase for food not eaten in.

clue.text: Western off? I disagree!

parts.note: food that is off is high, smelling of going bad
a reply of 'No, on!' disagrees with the word off

explanation.surface: Is the cowboy film cancelled? Someone objects.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' does two jobs in spirit: it is HIGH, and the retort 'No, on!' contradicts it.
explanation.definitionFit: High Noon is the 1952 Gary Cooper cowboy film, an example of a Western.

clue.text: Lucifer watches balloons

parts.note: Dis is a name for the god of the underworld, the devil
tends means looks after or watches over

explanation.surface: The devil keeps an eye on some party decorations.
explanation.definitionFit: To balloon is to swell out, which is what distending means.

clue.text: Western hospital insane?

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital, and insane split as in sane puts that letter inside the word sane

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether a hospital in the American West is a madhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark invites splitting 'insane' into 'in sane', so H sits inside SANE.
explanation.definitionFit: Shane is a classic 1953 cowboy film starring Alan Ladd, so it is an example of a Western.

clue.text: Into social values, time to silence bonds

indicators.note: Into says the following pieces go inside the word for social values

parts.note: mores are the customs and values of a society
to gag someone is to silence them

explanation.surface: A sociological musing about when society's values move to stifle commitments.
explanation.definitionFit: A mortgage is a legal pledge of property as security for a loan, a kind of financial bond.

clue.text: Air crewman prepared for action once

indicators.note: letters prepared are worked into a new shape, so the fodder is rearranged

explanation.surface: A member of an aircraft's crew gets ready to go into combat.
explanation.definitionFit: The Crimean War of 1853-56 was a military conflict of the past, so a historical action.

clue.text: Maiden name here, all may conclude

definitions.text: Maiden name here, all may conclude

indicators.note: each of the three opening words supplies its final letter, as all of them conclude

explanation.surface: Everyone agrees a woman's original surname belongs in this spot.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does both jobs: the endings of 'Maiden name here' spell the answer, which is where a maiden name would go.
explanation.definitionFit: Nee, meaning born, introduces a married woman's original family surname.

clue.text: Parent drinking bubbly reaches for a pipe

indicators.note: drinking says the parent word takes in the shuffled letters

parts.note: mum is a mother, a parent

indicators.note: bubbly suggests letters fizzing about, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A mother sipping champagne picks up a tobacco pipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bubbly' looks like champagne, but it rearranges REACHES to EERSCHA, which MUM drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A meerschaum is a tobacco pipe with a bowl carved from a soft white clay mineral.

clue.text: Officially, something temporarily held here with string

parts.note: to hold the fort is to look after things temporarily, so a fort is what is held
taken as written
cord is thin string

explanation.surface: A formal note that an item is being kept here for now, tied up with string.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'hold the fort' means to take charge for a while, which makes FORT the thing temporarily held.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying something is on the official record means it is stated formally, an idiom for officially.

clue.text: Justice, perhaps, as actor injured with dart

indicators.note: something injured is knocked out of shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A legal outcome sought by a performer hit by a dart.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Justice' reads as legal fairness, but it is one of the major arcana in a fortune-telling pack.
explanation.definitionFit: Justice is one of the major arcana in a fortune-teller's deck, so an example of the answer.

clue.text: Honest hand?

definitions.meaning: in poker, a run of five cards in sequence

explanation.surface: A query whether a card hand is fair.
explanation.definitionFit: Straight means frank and truthful, and is also a poker hand of five consecutive cards.

clue.text: Break fall, as bridle

parts.note: a rest is a break
rain falls, and a fall of rain is rain

explanation.surface: Cushioning a tumble is like reining in a horse.
explanation.definitionFit: To bridle at something is to curb or hold back, as one checks a horse.

clue.text: Western shooters mentioned here?

parts.note: these refers to the things being mentioned here
archers shoot arrows

explanation.surface: In a cowboy film, are these the gunslingers we are talking about?
explanation.definitionFit: The Searchers is a 1956 John Ford cowboy film starring John Wayne, an example of a Western.

clue.text: Country where god has topped priest

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild

indicators.note: topped means having its top cut off, so the first letter goes

parts.note: a lama is a Tibetan Buddhist priest

explanation.surface: A nation where one deity has killed a cleric.
explanation.walkthrough: 'topped' looks like 'killed', but means lose the head letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Panama is a nation in Central America.

clue.text: Entering the country, some extremists hunted

indicators.note: Entering says those letters go into the country

parts.note: Chad is a country in central Africa

indicators.note: extremists here means the extreme letters of the word some

explanation.surface: As they cross the border, radicals are pursued.
explanation.definitionFit: Chased means pursued, a synonym for hunted.

clue.text: Key accessing locks, thankfully all opening

indicators.note: the opening letter of each of the three following words is taken

explanation.surface: A key gets into the locks and, gratefully, everything opens.
explanation.definitionFit: Alt is a modifier button on a computer keyboard, so a keyboard key.

clue.text: Western drama tutor?

parts.note: the stage is the world of theatre and drama
a coach is a private tutor

explanation.surface: A frontier-set acting teacher?
explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoach is the 1939 John Ford cowboy film with John Wayne, an example of a Western.

clue.text: A badger in lift touring hot country

indicators.note: touring says the raised letters go round the hot letter
in lift says the pieces are raised, reading upwards in this down entry

parts.note: to badger is to nag
H is the abbreviation for hot, on taps

explanation.surface: An animal in an elevator travelling round a warm nation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'badger' looks like the animal, but is a verb, NAG. 'in lift' turns A NAG into GANA, which goes round H.
explanation.definitionFit: Ghana is a nation in West Africa.

clue.text: Country in Europe, Rumania

indicators.note: in says the letters sit inside the following words

explanation.surface: A list of a nation within Europe, namely Rumania.
explanation.definitionFit: Peru is a nation in South America.

clue.text: A weak little boat reversing around a country

indicators.note: around says the reversed string goes round the second a
reversing says the first three pieces run backwards

parts.note: lame means weak, as in a lame excuse
a tug is a small powerful boat

explanation.surface: A feeble small vessel turns round a nation's coast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reversing' runs the first three pieces backwards to GUTEMALA; 'around' then wraps that round the second A, after its first two letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Guatemala is a nation in Central America.

clue.text: Barrier breaks as US president

indicators.note: breaks says the barrier word splits open the word as

parts.note: a dam is a barrier across a river

explanation.surface: A wall gives way as the American leader looks on.
explanation.definitionFit: John Adams and John Quincy Adams were the second and sixth holders of the American presidency.

clue.text: Nude has got bum that's pronounced

indicators.note: bum means bad or faulty, so these letters are messed up

explanation.surface: A naked person has a backside that stands out prominently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bum' looks like a noun for the backside, but as an adjective meaning rubbish it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Tongued describes notes articulated with the tongue, as when playing a wind instrument, so they are sounded or articulated.

clue.text: Frenchman grasping black buoyancy aid

indicators.note: grasping says the man's name holds the black letter

parts.note: Armand is a French man's name
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A man from France holds on to a dark float.
explanation.definitionFit: An armband is an inflatable ring worn on the upper arm to help a child swim, a flotation device.
